description: This file sets up an HTTP server that serves static files, handles specific routes for axios library files, dynamically generates an index page listing directories, and processes server requests based on directory structure. It is an example server script for serving axios examples.

methods.name: listDirs
methods.description: Reads the directory contents of the specified root and returns a list of subdirectory names, excluding hidden files.

methods.name: getIndexTemplate
methods.description: Generates an HTML string for the index page with links to each directory.

methods.name: sendResponse
methods.description: Sends an HTTP response with specified status code and body.

methods.name: send200
methods.description: Sends a 200 OK response with optional body.

methods.name: send404
methods.description: Sends a 404 Not Found response with optional body.

methods.name: pipeFileToResponse
methods.description: Streams a file to the HTTP response with optional content type.
